name: ankle plantar flexion
interpretation: Seated left then right ankle plantar flexion from neutral, pointing the foot away from the shin, brief pause and controlled return. Foot and toes move coherently in the shin frame. This five-second demonstration shows one repetition per side, separate from the source10–15-repetition workout instruction.

source.description: Pointing the foot away from the shin, engaging the calf. Good for warming up and mobilising the ankle.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
